summary: Backend testing for Iteration 65 (Rest endpoints + travel event regression). Created /app/backend/tests/test_rest_endpoints_it65.py with 16 test cases covering POST /api/characters/{id}/rest/short, POST /api/characters/{id}/rest/long, regression on PATCH /hp, PATCH /shadow, and POST /api/travel/resolve-event. All 16 tests PASS against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: character_routes.py PATCH /{character_id} update endpoint does not include 'puntos_golpe_actual', 'dados_golpe_gastados', or 'fatiga' in allowed_fields. This is by design (dedicated endpoints exist) but worth documenting because tests had to use /hp PATCH and /fatigue PUT to set state. No bug.
rest/short min(1, roll+CON) is correct per 5e variant rule (each die heals at least 1).
rest/long uses LOTR house-rule: fatigue -1 (floor 0) on each long rest — confirmed working.
resolve-event uses query parameters, not JSON body — frontend must send query params (verified by tests).
test_credentials: Used Admin Backup Token only for context; no auth required for these endpoints.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing first character from GET /api/characters/. State reset between tests via long-rest (HP→max, fatigue→0) and PATCH /hp / PUT /fatigue helpers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests are idempotent: each test calls _full_reset (3 long rests) before mutating state, so they can be re-run. Character used: first one returned by GET /api/characters/ (currently id=c16a362d-..., nivel=1, pg_max=20, dado_golpe=1d8, CON=12). The PATCH /{character_id} endpoint silently drops disallowed fields (no 400 error), so future tests must use dedicated endpoints (/hp, /fatigue, /shadow, /xp, /rest/*) to mutate stat state.
verified_endpoints: POST /api/characters/{id}/rest/short — heal, clamp to dice available, clamp to max HP, dice_to_spend=0 no-op, negative clamps to 0, 404 unknown
POST /api/characters/{id}/rest/long — heals to max, recovers floor(level/2) min 1, fatigue -1 floor 0, 404 unknown
PATCH /api/characters/{id}/hp — negative damage works, floor 0 clamp
POST /api/travel/resolve-event — atajo (dias_reducidos=1), percance (dias_extra=1, fatigue_cd+2), desesperanza (puntos_sombra>=1), decisiones (puntos_sombra>=1), vista (inspiracion=true)
